datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,  hdate, facticaldebt, interestdebt, trid, inttrid
  FROM sbcm_payments
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     cont.amount,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid,
     cs.facticaldebt,
     cs.facticalinterestdebt
from customers cust,
     sbcm_contract_state cs,
     sbcm_contracts cont
where
cont.id = :ContractID and 
cust.id = cont.customerid
and cs.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: CustAcc
datasets.sql:
select clientaccid 
       ,sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo
       ,sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
from sbcm_contract_accounts
where id# = :Contractid
